headlines.description: — Marat Khusnutdinov scored 2:07 into overtime and the Boston Bruins beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marat Khusnutdinov scores in OT, Morgan Geekie has goal in 6th straight as Bruins beat Sabres 4-3

headlines.description: — Drake Batherson and Tim Stutzle scored in the shootout and the Ottawa Senators beat the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Batherson and Stutzle score in shootout, Senators beat Flames 4-3

events.name: Dallas Stars at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Anthony Cirelli scored 2:36 into overtime to lift the Tampa Bay Lightning to their fourth straight win, 2-1 over the Dallas Stars on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cirelli scores in OT as Lightning beat Stars for fourth straight win

headlines.description: — Trevor Zegras scored twice and added an assist to continue his home ice hot streak and the Philadelphia Flyers beat the Nashville Predators 4-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zegras stays hot at home with two goals and an assist in Flyers' 4-1 win over Predators

events.name: New York Islanders at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Andrei Svechnikov had a goal and an assist, Brandon Bussi had 26 saves and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the New York Islanders 6-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov helps Hurricanes roll past Islanders 6-2 for 2nd win in 5 games

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Keifer Sherwood had a hat trick, Jake DeBrusk scored the only goal in a shootout and the Vancouver Canucks beat the St. Louis Blues 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sherwood has hat trick, DeBrusk scores in shootout as Canucks beat Blues 4-3

headlines.description: — Bryan Rust had a goal and an assist, Tristan Jarry made 26 saves and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat Minnesota 4-1 on Thursday night to hand the Wild their fifth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rust has a goal and an assist as Penguins win 4-1 to send Wild to fifth straight loss

headlines.description: — Gabriel Villardi had two goals and an assist, and linemates Mark Scheifele and Kyle Connor each had a goal and a two assists as the Winnipeg Jets beat the Chicago Blackhawks 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Villardi, Scheifele, Connor each have 3 points as Jets beat Blackhawks 6-3

events.name: New York Rangers at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — J.T. Miller scored 2:49 into overtime and the New York Rangers erased a two-goal deficit to beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller scores in OT as Rangers rally to beat Oilers 4-3

events.name: New Jersey Devils at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — William Eklund scored in the opening minute to set the tone for San Jose and the Sharks earned their first home win of the season by beating the New Jersey Devils 5-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: San Jose Sharks earn first home win of the season with 5-2 victory over New Jersey Devils

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Lucas Raymond scored in the shootout and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Los Angeles Kings 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lucas Raymond scores in shootout as Red Wings beat Kings 4-3
